row.amal_said: تذكرة. تذكرة، تذاكر. ... تذكرة is a ticket.
row.why: Listening: asked 'إيش يعني تذاكر؟' (40:19) he attempted an answer and read it as 'I remember' (بتذكّر, then هزكر) - a wrong word, not a blank; she gave تذكرة = ticket (sheet 'ticket | Tazkara | تذكرة') and he still asked 'what's تزكر؟' at 41:01.

Not an error: قبل شهر is a correct way to say 'a month before' (her own 42:07 chat uses the same shape, '2abel kam yoam min el-safra'); her 'No' at 43:59 answers his 'After...', not his قبل شهر, and she then just supplied the fuller sentence أكتر من شهر قبل السفرة; neither C9 nor a new rule fits, and most of his line is an engine hole.
